Sandbox_DeadDaysStory.BuddyMortal_toolti: Off (default): buddies can be hurt but never killed by gunfire or the infected; only the story can take them. On: a buddy who dies stays dead, permanently.
Sandbox_DeadDaysStory.DailyOps_tooltip: Small jobs posted every morning at 6:00. Finishing all of them builds a streak; a 3+ day streak gives bonus XP.
Sandbox_DeadDaysStory.MaxLeads_tooltip: How many side missions (offered or active) the director keeps on a player's plate at once. Story chapters and daily ops don't count.
Sandbox_DeadDaysStory.IncidentRate_toolt: Chance, checked every 10 in-game minutes once 8 hours have passed since the last one, that something happens to a player: a distress call, or a raid if the warlord's faction is strong.
Sandbox_DeadDaysStory.LockALifeCreator: Lock the A-Life Creator and admin spawn menus
Sandbox_DeadDaysStory.LockALifeCreator_t: Hides Project A-Life's Creator and right-click spawn menus from everyone, including admins. The story system creates and spawns everything. Turn off to use the Creator yourself.
Sandbox_DeadDaysStory.ConvoysEnabled_too: Faction convoys travel the roads off-screen and stop at rest points. Near a player they appear as real vehicles with an armed escort you can ambush, avoid or follow.
